        check=True,
    ).stdout.decode("utf-8")
    entries = [entry for entry in raw.split("\0") if entry]
    paths = []
    for entry in entries:
        paths.append(entry[3:])
    return paths


def assign(paths: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[int, list[str]], list[str]]:
    buckets: dict[int, list[str]] = {index: [] for index in range(len(GROUPS))}
    leftover = []
    for path in paths:
        for index, (_, patterns, _) in enumerate(GROUPS):
            if any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(path, pattern) for pattern in patterns):
                buckets[index].append(path)
                break
        else:
            leftover.append(path)
    return buckets, leftover

"""Калибровочная выборка для скила test-junk-audit: тело теста и начало вызываемого кода carousel.

Факты: исходный текст функций и их определения. Вердикт здесь не выносится.
Пишет calib_bundle.md. Аргументы: --seed (по умолчанию 20261023), --n (по умолчанию 30).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import json
import pathlib
import random

ROOT = pathlib.Path("E:/repos/carousel-demo")
PROOF = ROOT / "runs/_observability/proof_tests_20261022.json"
OUT = ROOT / "runs/_observability/skills/test-junk-audit"


def function_node(tree: ast.Module, name: str, line: int) -> ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef | None:
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == name:
            if node.lineno == line or (node.decorator_list and node.decorator_list[0].lineno <= line <= node.lineno):
                return node
    return None


def carousel_index() -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, int]]]:
    index: dict[str, list[tuple[str, int]]] = {}
    for path in sorted((ROOT / "carousel").rglob("*.py")):
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
                index.setdefault(node.name, []).append((path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), node.lineno))
    return index


def snippet(file: str, line: int, lines: int = 14) -> str:
    text = (ROOT / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    return "\n".join(f"{n + 1:5} {text[n]}" for n in range(line - 1, min(len(text), line - 1 + lines)))


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261023)
    parser.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=30)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rows = json.loads(PROOF.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    chosen = random.Random(args.seed).sample(rows, args.n)
    index = carousel_index()
    out: list[str] = [f"# Калибровочная выборка: seed {args.seed}, n {args.n}", ""]
    for row in chosen:
        src = (ROOT / row["file"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        tree = ast.parse(src)
        node = function_node(tree, row["name"], row["line"])
        nodeid = f"{row['file']}::{row['name']}"
        out.append(f"## {nodeid}  (строка {row['line']}, покрыто строк проекта: {row['carousel_lines']})")
        if node is None:
            out.append("НЕ НАЙДЕНА В ФАЙЛЕ")
            out.append("")
            continue
        body_src = ast.get_source_segment(src, node) or ""
        out.append("```python")
        out.append(body_src)
        out.append("```")
        names = {n.id for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Name)}
        names |= {n.attr for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Attribute)}
        local_defs = {n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
        shown = 0
        for name in sorted(names):
            if name in local_defs or name not in index or shown >= 3:
                continue
            defs = index[name]
            if len(defs) != 1:
                continue
            file, line = defs[0]
            out.append(f"### производственный код: `{name}` — {file}:{line}")
            out.append("```python")
            out.append(snippet(file, line))
            out.append("```")
            shown += 1
        out.append("")
    (OUT / "calib_bundle.md").write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"записано: {OUT / 'calib_bundle.md'}")
    print("функций:", len(chosen))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def functions(path: pathlib.Path) -> list[ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef]:
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))]


def start_line(node: ast.AST) -> int:
    decorators = getattr(node, "decorator_list", [])
    return decorators[0].lineno if decorators else node.lineno  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


def locate(path: pathlib.Path, spec: int | str) -> ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef | None:
    funcs = functions(path)
    if isinstance(spec, int):
        for node in funcs:
            if start_line(node) <= spec <= node.end_lineno:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                return node
        return None
    hits = [n for n in funcs if n.name == spec]
    return hits[0] if hits else None


def body(node: ast.AST) -> list[ast.stmt]:
    stmts = list(node.body)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    if stmts and isinstance(stmts[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(stmts[0].value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(stmts[0].value.value, str):
        stmts = stmts[1:]
    return stmts


def local_names(node: ast.AST) -> set[str]:
    names = {a.arg for a in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(a, ast.arg)}
    names |= {n.id for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Store)}
    return names


class Alpha(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def __init__(self, local: set[str]) -> None:
        self.local = local
        self.map: dict[str, str] = {}

    def visit_Name(self, node: ast.Name) -> ast.Name:
        if node.id in self.local:
            node.id = self.map.setdefault(node.id, f"_v{len(self.map)}")
        return node

    def visit_arg(self, node: ast.arg) -> ast.arg:
        if node.arg in self.local:
            node.arg = self.map.setdefault(node.arg, f"_v{len(self.map)}")
        return node


def normal(node: ast.AST) -> list[str]:
    stmts = copy.deepcopy(body(node))
    alpha = Alpha(local_names(node))
    return [ast.dump(alpha.visit(s)) for s in stmts]


def checks(node: ast.AST) -> list[str]:
    out = []
    for n in ast.walk(node):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Assert):
            out.append(ast.dump(n))
        if isinstance(n, (ast.With, ast.AsyncWith)):
            for item in n.items:
                ctx = item.context_expr
                if isinstance(ctx, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(ctx.func).endswith("raises"):
                    out.append(ast.unparse(ctx))
    return out


def source(path: pathlib.Path, node: ast.AST) -> str:
    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    return "\n".join(lines[start_line(node) - 1 : node.end_lineno])  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

        jc, tc = checks(junk), checks(twin)

    return [ast.dump(n) for s in stmts for n in ast.walk(s) if isinstance(n, ast.Assert)]


def main() -> None:
    body_same = assert_same = args_same = 0
    rows = []
    for junk_file, junk_name, twin_file, twin_spec in PAIRS:

        ja, ta = asserts(jb), asserts(tb)
        a_eq = ja == ta
        args_eq = ast.dump(junk.args) == ast.dump(twin.args)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

def functions(path: pathlib.Path) -> list[ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef]:
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))]


def start_line(node: ast.AST) -> int:
    decorators = getattr(node, "decorator_list", [])
    return decorators[0].lineno if decorators else node.lineno  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


def locate(path: pathlib.Path, spec: int | str) -> ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef | None:
    funcs = functions(path)
    if isinstance(spec, int):
        for node in funcs:
            if start_line(node) <= spec <= node.end_lineno:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
                return node
        return None
    hits = [n for n in funcs if n.name == spec]
    return hits[0] if hits else None


def body(node: ast.AST) -> list[ast.stmt]:
    stmts = list(node.body)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    if stmts and isinstance(stmts[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(stmts[0].value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(stmts[0].value.value, str):
        stmts = stmts[1:]
    return stmts


def local_names(node: ast.AST) -> set[str]:
    names = {a.arg for a in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(a, ast.arg)}
    names |= {n.id for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Store)}
    return names


class Alpha(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def __init__(self, local: set[str]) -> None:
        self.local = local
        self.map: dict[str, str] = {}

    def visit_Name(self, node: ast.Name) -> ast.Name:
        if node.id in self.local:
            node.id = self.map.setdefault(node.id, f"_v{len(self.map)}")
        return node

    def visit_arg(self, node: ast.arg) -> ast.arg:
        if node.arg in self.local:
            node.arg = self.map.setdefault(node.arg, f"_v{len(self.map)}")
        return node


def normal(node: ast.AST) -> list[str]:
    stmts = copy.deepcopy(body(node))
    alpha = Alpha(local_names(node))
    return [ast.dump(alpha.visit(s)) for s in stmts]


def checks(node: ast.AST) -> list[str]:
    out = []
    for n in ast.walk(node):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Assert):
            out.append(ast.dump(n))
        if isinstance(n, (ast.With, ast.AsyncWith)):
            for item in n.items:
                ctx = item.context_expr
                if isinstance(ctx, ast.Call) and ast.unparse(ctx.func).endswith("raises"):
                    out.append(ast.unparse(ctx))
    return out


def source(path: pathlib.Path, node: ast.AST) -> str:
    lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    return "\n".join(lines[start_line(node) - 1 : node.end_lineno])  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

        junk_path, twin_path = ROOT / junk_file, ROOT / twin_file

            continue
        b_eq = normal(junk) == normal(twin)
        c_eq = [ast.dump(ast.parse(c, mode="eval") if False else ast.Constant(0)) for c in []] == []
        jc, tc = checks(junk), checks(twin)
        c_eq = len(jc) == len(tc) and sorted(jc) == sorted(tc)
        args_eq = ast.dump(junk.args) == ast.dump(twin.args)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        body_same += b_eq
        check_same += c_eq
        args_same += args_eq
        summary.append(

            f"вход={'=' if args_eq else '≠'} | {junk.name} (стр. {start_line(junk)}, проверок {len(jc)}) "
            f"<> {twin.name} ({twin_file}:{start_line(twin)}, проверок {len(tc)})"

        report += [f"## {index:02d}. {label}", f"### близнец {twin.name} — {twin_file}", "```python",

Вход — groups/group{1..6}.tsv. Выход — lite/lite_NN.md (PARTS пачек, нумерация сквозная 1..N) и lite/index.tsv.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import pathlib

ROOT = pathlib.Path("E:/repos/carousel-demo")
BASE = ROOT / "runs/_observability/skills/test-junk-audit"
PARTS = 10
MAX_LINES = 60


def function_source(src_lines: list[str], tree: ast.Module, name: str, line: int) -> str:
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == name:
            start = node.decorator_list[0].lineno if node.decorator_list else node.lineno
            if start <= line <= node.end_lineno:
                body = src_lines[start - 1 : node.end_lineno]
                if len(body) > MAX_LINES:
                    body = body[:MAX_LINES] + [f"    # … ещё {len(body) - MAX_LINES} строк"]
                return "\n".join(body)
    return "НЕ НАЙДЕНА"


def main() -> None:
    rows: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for group in range(1, 7):
        lines = (BASE / "groups" / f"group{group}.tsv").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[1:]
        for line in lines:
            nodeid, lineno, cases, _carousel = line.split("\t")
            rows.append((nodeid, lineno, cases))
    trees: dict[str, tuple[list[str], ast.Module]] = {}
    out_dir = BASE / "lite"
    out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for old in out_dir.glob("lite_*.md"):
        old.unlink()
    size = -(-len(rows) // PARTS)
    index = ["n\tnodeid\tcases"]
    for part in range(PARTS):
        chunk = rows[part * size : (part + 1) * size]
        if not chunk:
            continue
        first = part * size + 1
        text = [f"# Пачка {part + 1:02d}: функции {first}–{first + len(chunk) - 1}", ""]
        for offset, (nodeid, lineno, cases) in enumerate(chunk):
            number = first + offset
            file, name = nodeid.split("::", 1)
            if file not in trees:
                src = (ROOT / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                trees[file] = (src.splitlines(), ast.parse(src))
            src_lines, tree = trees[file]
            case_note = f", кейсов {cases}" if cases != "1" else ""
            text += [f"## {number} {file}{case_note}", "```python",
                     function_source(src_lines, tree, name, int(lineno)), "```", ""]
            index.append(f"{number}\t{nodeid}\t{cases}")
        (out_dir / f"lite_{part + 1:02d}.md").write_text("\n".join(text) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (out_dir / "index.tsv").write_text("\n".join(index) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"функций: {len(rows)}, пачек: {PARTS}, по {size}")

"""Сводка вердиктов обхода и удаление тестов JUNK по AST.

Без --apply только считает и пишет сводку. С --apply удаляет функции вместе с декораторами.
Номер функции = порядок строк в groups/group1..6.tsv (тот же, что в make_lite.py).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import collections
import pathlib
import re

ROOT = pathlib.Path("E:/repos/carousel-demo")
BASE = ROOT / "runs/_observability/skills/test-junk-audit"
LINE = re.compile(r"^\s*(\d+)\s*;;\s*(KEEP|JUNK)\s*;;\s*([^;]*?)\s*;;\s*(.*)$", re.IGNORECASE)


def load_functions() -> list[tuple[str, str, int, int]]:
    rows: list[tuple[str, str, int, int]] = []
    for group in range(1, 7):
        lines = (BASE / "groups" / f"group{group}.tsv").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[1:]
        for line in lines:
            nodeid, lineno, cases, _ = line.split("\t")
            file, name = nodeid.split("::", 1)
            rows.append((file, name, int(lineno), int(cases)))
    return rows


def load_verdicts(folder: pathlib.Path) -> tuple[dict[int, tuple[str, str, str]], list[str]]:
    verdicts: dict[int, tuple[str, str, str]] = {}
    bad: list[str] = []
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("lite_*_p*.txt")):
        for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            if not raw.strip():
                continue
            match = LINE.match(raw)
            if not match:
                bad.append(f"{path.name}: {raw[:100]}")
                continue
            number = int(match.group(1))
            if number in verdicts and verdicts[number][0] != match.group(2).upper():
                bad.append(f"{path.name}: повтор с другим вердиктом {number}")
            verdicts[number] = (match.group(2).upper(), match.group(3).strip().upper(), match.group(4).strip())
    return verdicts, bad


def remove_functions(file: pathlib.Path, targets: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> int:
    src = file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    lines = src.splitlines(keepends=True)
    tree = ast.parse(src)
    spans: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for name, line in targets:
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == name:
                start = node.decorator_list[0].lineno if node.decorator_list else node.lineno
                if start <= line <= node.end_lineno:
                    spans.append((start, node.end_lineno))
                    break
        else:
            raise SystemExit(f"не найдена {file.name}::{name} на строке {line}")
    for start, end in sorted(spans, reverse=True):
        del lines[start - 1 : end]
    new_src = "".join(lines)
    ast.parse(new_src)
    tmp = file.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(new_src, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    tmp.replace(file)
    return len(spans)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--verdicts", default="verdicts2")
    parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--exclude", default="", help="файлы через запятую: не трогать")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    funcs = load_functions()
    verdicts, bad = load_verdicts(BASE / args.verdicts)
    missing = [n for n in range(1, len(funcs) + 1) if n not in verdicts]
    keep = [n for n, v in verdicts.items() if v[0] == "KEEP"]
    junk = [n for n, v in verdicts.items() if v[0] == "JUNK"]
    cases = lambda ns: sum(funcs[n - 1][3] for n in ns)  # noqa: E731
    print(f"функций {len(funcs)}, вердиктов {len(verdicts)}, без вердикта {len(missing)}, нечитаемых строк {len(bad)}")
    print(f"KEEP {len(keep)} ({cases(keep)} кейсов), JUNK {len(junk)} ({cases(junk)} кейсов)")
    kinds = collections.Counter(verdicts[n][1] for n in junk)
    print("JUNK по видам:", dict(kinds.most_common()))
    kinds_keep = collections.Counter(verdicts[n][1] for n in keep)
    print("KEEP по пользе:", dict(kinds_keep.most_common()))
    per_file: dict[str, list[int]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for n in junk:
        per_file[funcs[n - 1][0]].append(n)
    total_file = collections.Counter(f for f, *_ in funcs)
    out = [f"{f}\t{len(ns)}/{total_file[f]}" for f, ns in sorted(per_file.items())]
    (BASE / "apply_summary.tsv").write_text("file\tjunk/total\n" + "\n".join(out) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (BASE / "apply_missing.txt").write_text("\n".join(map(str, missing)) + "\n" + "\n".join(bad) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import random
import sys

from apply_verdicts import BASE, ROOT, load_functions, load_verdicts


def body(file: str, name: str, line: int, limit: int = 45) -> str:
    src = (ROOT / file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    lines = src.splitlines()
    for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == name:
            start = node.decorator_list[0].lineno if node.decorator_list else node.lineno
            if start <= line <= node.end_lineno:
                chunk = lines[start - 1 : node.end_lineno]
                more = len(chunk) - limit
                return "\n".join(chunk[:limit]) + (f"\n    # … ещё {more} строк" if more > 0 else "")
    return "?"


def main() -> None:
    kind, count, seed = sys.argv[1].upper(), int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])

    for n in sorted(pool[:count]):
        file, name, line, cases = funcs[n - 1]

        print(f"=== {n} {file}::{name} [{v[0]} {v[1]}] {v[2]}")

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from apply_verdicts import BASE, load_verdicts

PARTS = 6


def sections() -> dict[int, str]:
    found: dict[int, str] = {}
    for path in sorted((BASE / "lite").glob("lite_*.md")):
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for block in re.split(r"(?m)^(?=## \d+ )", text):
            match = re.match(r"## (\d+) ", block)
            if match:
                found[int(match.group(1))] = block.rstrip() + "\n"
    return found


def main() -> None:
    verdicts, _ = load_verdicts(BASE / "verdicts2")
    blocks = sections()
    keep = sorted(n for n, v in verdicts.items() if v[0] == "KEEP")
    out = BASE / "lite2"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for old in out.glob("lite2_*.md"):
        old.unlink()
    size = -(-len(keep) // PARTS)
    for part in range(PARTS):
        chunk = keep[part * size : (part + 1) * size]
        lines = [f"# Пачка {part + 1}: {len(chunk)} функций с вердиктом KEEP первого прохода", ""]
        for n in chunk:
            claimed = f"{verdicts[n][1]}: {verdicts[n][2]}"
            head, rest = blocks[n].split("\n", 1)
            lines += [head, f"Заявлено первым проходом — {claimed}", rest]
        (out / f"lite2_{part + 1:02d}.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"KEEP: {len(keep)}, пачек: {PARTS}, по {size}")

import os
import pathlib


def edit(path, pairs):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    crlf = b"\r\n" in raw
    t = raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    for old, new in pairs:
        assert t.count(old) == 1, (path, old[:90], t.count(old))
        t = t.replace(old, new)

        t = t.replace("\n", "\r\n")

    tmp.write_bytes(t.encode("utf-8"))
    os.replace(tmp, p)

import os
import pathlib


def edit(path, pairs):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    crlf = b"\r\n" in raw
    t = raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    for old, new in pairs:
        assert t.count(old) == 1, (path, old[:90], t.count(old))
        t = t.replace(old, new)
    if crlf:
        t = t.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    tmp = p.with_name(p.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(t.encode("utf-8"))
    os.replace(tmp, p)


def append(path, text):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    crlf = b"\r\n" in raw
    t = raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    if not t.endswith("\n"):
        t += "\n"
    t += text
    if crlf:
        t = t.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    tmp = p.with_name(p.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(t.encode("utf-8"))
    os.replace(tmp, p)

def options(**changes: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = valid_data(reader={**valid_data()["reader"], "terms": []})

    data["theses"] = [{**t, "facts": [i]} for i, t in enumerate(data["theses"])]

        ],
        voice="Практик",
        catch=None,
        action=None,
    )
    return {**data, **changes}


def says(data: Any) -> Says:
    return Says(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), usage=USAGE)


async def choose(root: Path, responses: list[Says], proposal: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Analysis:
    write_model(root / "post.json", make_post())

        clock=FakeClock(), process="choice",
    )
    return Analysis.model_validate_json((root / "analysis.json").read_bytes())

        Message(role="user", content=prefix + "Материал:\n" + proposals.model_dump_json()),
    ), ClaimReview.bound_to(len(proposals.options)))
    write_model(generation / "review.json", review)
    pairs = []

        for order, a, b in (("ab", first, second), ("ba", second, first)):
            candidates = []
            for position, n in (("A", a), ("B", b)):
                option = proposals.options[n]
                support = "\n".join(f"- {proposals.facts[i].text}\n  {proposals.facts[i].anchor}" for i in option.premises)
                candidates.append(f"Вариант {position}: {option.text}\nОпоры:\n{support}")
            vote, meta = await call(f"choice-{first}-{second}-{order}", (
                Message(role="system", content=CHOICE_CRITERIA + "\nСравни A и B. Ответ: winner A/B/tie, reason. Порядок не преимущество; равные ответы могут получить tie."),
                Message(role="user", content=prefix + "\n".join(candidates)),
            ), ClaimPreference)
            votes.append(vote)
            calls.append(meta)
        pairs.append(ClaimPair(first=first, second=second, forward=votes[0], reverse=votes[1]))
    choice = MainIdeaChoice.of(review, pairs)
    write_model(generation / "choice.json", choice)
    write_model(generation / "report.json", GenerationReport(
        draft=1, reflection=None,

    ))
    if choice.selected is None:
        raise ModelCallError(choice.reason)
    return proposals.select(choice.selected, choice.reason), calls

# это имена требований и технологий, а не предмет поста.
NAME = re.compile(r"\b[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{2,}\b")


def corpus() -> dict[str, str]:
    """По одному тексту на пост: заголовок и блоки. Копии прогонов одного поста сливаются по slug."""
    posts: dict[str, str] = {}
    for path in sorted(RUNS.glob("*/post.json")):
        doc = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        slug = doc.get("slug") or path.parent.name
        if slug in posts:
            continue
        blocks = [block.get("text") or "" for block in doc.get("blocks") or []]
        posts[slug] = "\n".join([doc.get("title") or "", *blocks])
    return posts


def facts_of_one_post(posts: dict[str, str]) -> set[str]:
    """Суммы, проценты и величины, встречающиеся ровно в одном посте корпуса."""
    owner: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for slug, text in posts.items():
        found = {match.strip() for pattern in FACT for match in pattern.findall(text)}
        for fact in found:
            owner.setdefault(fact.replace("\n", " "), set()).add(slug)
    return {fact for fact, slugs in owner.items() if len(slugs) == 1 and len(fact) >= 3}


def names_of_one_post(posts: dict[str, str]) -> set[str]:
    """Имена продуктов, встречающиеся ровно в одном посте корпуса.

    Меры сравнения из `brand/landscape.toml` не в счёт: их ведёт автор, и в задании они стоят по
    правилу DR-12, а не как факт поста.
    """
    landscape = (REPO / "brand" / "landscape.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    owner: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for slug, text in posts.items():
        for name in NAME.findall(text):
            if name.isupper() or name in landscape:
                continue
            owner.setdefault(name, set()).add(slug)
    return {name for name, slugs in owner.items() if len(slugs) == 1}


def leaks(needles: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Строки заданий и скиллов, в которых стоит факт одного поста: файл, строка, находка."""
    found: list[str] = []
    for path in PROMPTS:
        if not path.exists():
            continue
        for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), start=1):
            hits = [needle for needle in needles if needle in line]
            if hits:
                where = path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
                found.append(f"{where}:{number}: {' | '.join(sorted(hits))}")
    return found


def test_dr14_the_instructions_of_the_model_hold_no_fact_of_one_post() -> None:
    """Задание и скилл не содержат суммы, процента, величины или имени одного поста (DR-14).

def assistant_texts(path: str) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    """Текстовые блоки ответов ассистента с номером строки файла."""
    out: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as handle:

            try:

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class ResponseCache:
    """Хранит ответы модели на диске по хешу входа."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _path(self, key: str) -> Path:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return self.root / f"{digest}.json"

    def get(self, key: str) -> Any | None:
        path = self._path(key)
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        raw = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        return json.loads(raw)

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        path = self._path(key)
        payload = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
        path.write_text(payload, encoding="utf-8")

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class AnswerStore:
    """Сохраняет ответы рядом с прогоном."""

    def __init__(self, base: Path) -> None:
        self.base = base
        self.base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _file(self, text: str) -> Path:
        value = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        return self.base / f"{value}.json"

    def load(self, text: str) -> Any | None:
        target = self._file(text)
        if not target.exists():
            return None
        body = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        return json.loads(body)

    def save(self, text: str, data: Any) -> None:
        target = self._file(text)
        blob = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
        target.write_text(blob, encoding="utf-8")

import sys
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path

from langfuse import get_client

run_dir = (Path("runs") / sys.argv[1]).resolve()
after = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else ""
session = sha256(str(run_dir).encode()).hexdigest()
lf = get_client()
cursor = None

    )

        if stamp < after:
            continue

            print(stamp, o.name, d.get("level"), str(d.get("status_message"))[:600])

    if not cursor or not page.data:
        break

class FailingThenAskingForTexts(AskingForTexts):
    """Шаг story, который в первый раз падает до вопроса, а при продолжении спрашивает автора."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.failed = False

    async def __call__(self, state: RunState) -> Answer:
        if not self.failed:
            self.failed = True
            raise ModelCallError("provider_failure", "сверщик отказал")
        return await super().__call__(state)


async def test_us23_a_step_that_failed_and_stops_at_its_question_on_the_resume_waits_and_has_no_failure(
    run_dir: Path,
) -> None:
    """LangGraph не стирает запись об ошибке задачи: после продолжения у неё есть и прежняя ошибка,
    и новая остановка без ответа. Прогон ждёт автора, прежняя ошибка не считается."""
    story = FailingThenAskingForTexts()
    failed = await start(run_dir, steps_of(story=story), stop_after="story")
    assert failed.failures == {"story": "сверщик отказал"}

    waiting = await resume(run_dir, story=story)

    assert waiting == Progress(
        url=URL,
        finished=dict.fromkeys(STEPS[: STEPS.index("story")], "done"),
        unfinished=("story",),
        waiting=TEXTS_QUESTION,
    )
    assert await read_progress(run_dir) == waiting
    done = await answer(run_dir, REPLY, story=story)
    assert done == Progress(url=URL, finished=DONE)
    assert story.heard == [REPLY]

import os
import pathlib


def edit(path, pairs):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for old, new in pairs:
        assert t.count(old) == 1, (path, old[:70])
        t = t.replace(old, new)
    tmp = p.with_name(p.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, p)

"""Суть поста: прочтения и точки ответа агента суть (`EssenceAnswer`).

DR-01, CR-07; ARCHITECTURE §3, «Разбор поста» (суть полного ответа). Якоря, посылки главного
утверждения и номера тезисов сверяет полный разбор (`tests/test_analysis.py`).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from samples import valid_essence_answer

from carousel.schemas import EssenceAnswer


def test_dr01_exactly_one_reading_is_the_claim() -> None:
    data = valid_essence_answer()
    data["candidates"][1]["verdict"] = "claim"

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="ровно одно прочтение — claim"):
        EssenceAnswer.model_validate(data)


def test_dr01_a_catch_point_needs_its_reading_and_a_reading_needs_its_point() -> None:
    no_reading = valid_essence_answer()
    no_reading["candidates"][1]["verdict"] = "dropped"
    no_point = valid_essence_answer(catch=None)

    for data in (no_reading, no_point):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="catch"):
            EssenceAnswer.model_validate(data)


def test_dr01_the_catch_stands_where_its_reading_stands() -> None:
    data = valid_essence_answer()
    data["catch"]["anchor"] = "выдумала 91% ответов"

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="якорь точки catch"):
        EssenceAnswer.model_validate(data)

import os
import pathlib


def edit(path, pairs):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for old, new in pairs:
        assert t.count(old) == 1, (path, old[:80])
        t = t.replace(old, new)
    tmp = p.with_name(p.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(tmp, p)

import os
import pathlib


def edit(path, pairs):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    crlf = b"\r\n" in raw
    t = raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    for old, new in pairs:
        assert t.count(old) == 1, (path, old[:90], t.count(old))
        t = t.replace(old, new)
    if crlf:
        t = t.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    tmp = p.with_name(p.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(t.encode("utf-8"))

import os

def edit(path, pairs, append=None):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    crlf = b"\r\n" in raw
    t = raw.decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    for old, new in pairs:

        t = t.replace(old, new)
    if append:
        assert t.endswith("\n")
        t += append
    if crlf:
        t = t.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    tmp = p.with_name(p.name + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(t.encode("utf-8"))
    os.replace(tmp, p)

) -> None:

    generation = generation_summary(run_dir, tuple(item.letter for item in texts))

    )


def generation_summary(run_dir: Path, letters: tuple[Letter, ...]) -> GenerationSummary:
    reports: dict[str, GenerationReport] = {}
    issues: list[ReflectionNote] = []
    unchecked: list[str] = []
    skipped: dict[str, str] = {}
    tasks = {"analyze": "generation/analyze/report.json"} | {
        f"story/{letter}": f"generation/story/{letter}/report.json" for letter in letters
    }
    for task, filename in tasks.items():
        path = run_dir / filename
        if not path.is_file():
            trace = run_dir / meta_file(ANALYZE_STEP)
            if task == ANALYZE_STEP and trace.is_file():
                calls = read_model(trace, StepMeta).calls
                if calls and all(call.task in (None, "analysis", "terms") for call in calls):
                    skipped[task] = (
                        "Исследовательский цикл не настроен: одиночный разбор без рефлексии"
                    )
                    continue
            unchecked.append(task)
            continue
        report = read_model(path, GenerationReport)
        reports[task] = report
        issues += [
            note.model_copy(update={"location": f"{task}: {note.location}"})
            for note in report.reflection.notes
        ]
    for letter in letters:
        path = run_dir / plan_file(letter, "review.json")
        if not path.is_file():
            unchecked.append(f"plan/{letter}")
            continue
        review = read_model(path, PlanReview)
        issues += [
            ReflectionNote(
                location=f"plan/{letter}: "
                + (f"карточка {note.card}" if note.card else "вся история"),
                problem=note.point,
                task=note.point,
                quote=note.quote,
            )
            for note in review.objections
        ]
    return GenerationSummary(reports=reports, issues=issues, unchecked=unchecked, skipped=skipped)

        kind: FailureKind,
        message: str,
        *,
        retryable: bool = False,
        attempts: tuple[Attempt, ...] = (),
        raw: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:

        self.kind: FailureKind = kind
        self.retryable = retryable
        self.attempts = attempts
        self.raw = raw

by_task: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(lambda: [0.0, 0])

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError
from story_samples import (
    A_BENCH,

    QUOTE_TEXT,

    rich_analysis,
    rich_post,
)

from carousel.cards import MetricsElement, ParagraphElement, QuoteElement, TitleElement

LIMITS = CardLimits(max_cards=10, exact=None)


def free_card(role: str, title: str, body: list[str], /, **overrides: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    data: dict[str, Any] = {
        "title": title,
        "body": body,
        "figure": None,
        "quote": None,
        "role": role,
        "job": f"Работа карточки {role}",
        "picture": False,
    }
    data.update(overrides)
    return data


def free_data(**overrides: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Шесть карточек по образцу поста: у каждой в тексте есть дословные куски поста."""
    data: dict[str, Any] = {
        "through_line": "счёт, который растёт быстрее обещания",
        "structure": "explain",
        "tone": "calm",
        "rationale": "Начинаю с обещания и счёта, потом объясняю, откуда он взялся.",
        "cards": [
            free_card(
                "cover",
                "Безлимит за 20 долларов, а счёт вышел на 3 790 долларов",
                ["Один пользователь потратил 8,13 млрд токенов за неделю."],
                picture=True,
            ),
            free_card("lead", "Что случилось", [SENTENCES[0]]),
            free_card("mechanism", "Откуда счёт", [SENTENCES[2]]),
            free_card(
                "numbers",
                "Качество",
                ["Terminal-Bench проверил модель и дал ей 61% успеха."],
                figure={"value": "61%", "label": "успеха на Terminal-Bench"},
            ),
            free_card(
                "caveat",
                "Безлимит не вечен",
                ["Потом условия изменятся."],
                quote={"text": QUOTE_TEXT, "source": "Cognition"},
            ),
            free_card("finale", "Что делать", ["Держи Devin на коротком поводке."], picture=True),
        ],
    }
    data.update(overrides)
    return data


def bound(limits: CardLimits = LIMITS, share: float = 0.67) -> type[FreeStory]:
    return FreeStory.bound_to(rich_post(), limits, picture_share=share)


def test_dr12_a_free_story_becomes_a_story_with_cover_and_closing_layouts() -> None:
    free = bound().model_validate(free_data())

    story = free.to_story(rich_post())

    assert [card.layout for card in story.cards] == [
        "cover",
        "text",
        "text",
        "numbers",
        "quote",
        "closing",
    ]
    assert [card.role for card in story.cards] == [card.role for card in free.cards]
    assert story.through_line == "счёт, который растёт быстрее обещания"
    assert (story.axes.structure, story.axes.tone) == ("explain", "calm")
    assert story.rationale == free.rationale


def test_dr12_the_elements_of_a_card_follow_the_order_title_special_paragraphs() -> None:
    free = bound().model_validate(free_data())

    story = free.to_story(rich_post())

    numbers, quote_card = story.cards[3], story.cards[4]
    assert [type(e) for e in numbers.elements] == [TitleElement, MetricsElement, ParagraphElement]
    assert [type(e) for e in quote_card.elements] == [TitleElement, QuoteElement, ParagraphElement]
    metrics = numbers.elements[1]
    assert isinstance(metrics, MetricsElement)
    assert [(m.value, m.label) for m in metrics.items] == [("61%", "успеха на Terminal-Bench")]
    assert metrics.anchors  # место цифры в посте нашёл код


def test_cr07_anchors_are_post_fragments_found_by_code_and_text_without_one_is_service() -> None:
    free = bound().model_validate(
        free_data(
            cards=[
                *free_data()["cards"][:1],
                free_card("lead", "Короткий вопрос", ["Совсем другие слова без общих кусков."]),
                *free_data()["cards"][2:],
            ]
        )
    )

    story = free.to_story(rich_post())

    cover_paragraph = story.cards[0].elements[1]
    assert isinstance(cover_paragraph, ParagraphElement)
    assert cover_paragraph.text_class == "retell"
    assert "потратил 8,13 млрд токенов" in cover_paragraph.anchors
    foreign = story.cards[1].elements[1]
    assert isinstance(foreign, ParagraphElement)
    assert (foreign.text_class, foreign.anchors) == ("service", [])


def test_cr07_every_anchor_stands_in_the_post_and_is_long_enough() -> None:
    post = rich_post()
    free = bound().model_validate(free_data())

    story = free.to_story(post)

    assert list(story.anchors())
    markdown = " ".join(post.to_markdown().split())
    for _, anchor in story.anchors():
        assert anchor in markdown
        assert len(anchor) >= MIN_ANCHOR_LENGTH


def test_cr07_a_derived_story_passes_its_own_bound_schema() -> None:

    free = bound().model_validate(free_data())

    plan = free.to_plan(story, rich_analysis())

    cards = free_data()["cards"]
    cards[4]["quote"] = {"text": "Безлимит навсегда", "source": "Cognition"}

def test_dr12_a_card_holds_one_to_three_paragraphs_and_not_both_figure_and_quote() -> None:
    cards = free_data()["cards"]
    cards[1]["body"] = []
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="абзац"):
        bound().model_validate(free_data(cards=cards))

    cards = free_data()["cards"]
    cards[1]["body"] = ["Один.", "Два.", "Три.", "Четыре."]
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="абзац"):
        bound().model_validate(free_data(cards=cards))

    cards = free_data()["cards"]
    cards[3]["quote"] = {"text": QUOTE_TEXT, "source": "Cognition"}

        bound().model_validate(free_data(cards=cards))


def test_fr30_the_count_fits_the_limits_and_the_exact_request() -> None:
    cards = free_data()["cards"]
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="не меньше"):
        bound().model_validate(free_data(cards=[cards[0], cards[-1]]))

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="не больше 5"):
        bound(CardLimits(max_cards=5, exact=None)).model_validate(free_data())

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="ровно 4"):

def test_dr11_cover_comes_first_finale_last_and_each_only_once() -> None:

def test_dr11_the_cover_has_a_picture_and_pictures_stay_within_the_share() -> None:
    cards = free_data()["cards"]

def test_dr11_the_derived_plan_describes_the_text_without_requiring_anything() -> None:
    post, analysis = rich_post(), rich_analysis()
    free = bound().model_validate(free_data())
    story = free.to_story(post)

    plan = free.to_plan(story, analysis)

    assert [(beat.role, beat.job, beat.picture) for beat in plan.beats] == [
        (card.role, card.job, card.picture) for card in free.cards
    ]
    assert plan.reason == free.rationale
    assert plan.bridge == free.cards[-1].job

    assert 2 in plan.beats[5].carries
    assert 1 in plan.beats[2].carries  # «Основную часть счёта составил Cache Read»
    assert plan.left_for_post == []
    Plan.bound_to(analysis, LIMITS, picture_share=0.67).model_validate(plan.model_dump())

def test_cr07_fragments_are_whole_words_of_the_text_in_the_order_of_the_text() -> None:

GENERATION_DIR = "generation"  # первый ответ писателя: generation/story/<k>/answer.json
ANSWER_JSON = "answer.json"
MOVE_JSON = "move.json"  # ход слота в рабочей папке арт-директора и починки
PLAN_JSON = "plan.json"  # план слота там же
STAGE = "Первый ответ писателя"  # подпись стадии на странице текстов

PlanFile = Literal["json", "md"]

SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
Ты пишешь карусель для соцсети по посту блога «Аи помогатор»: квадратные карточки, их листают в \
ленте.

Читатель — программист или вайбкодер. Он год пишет код с агентами и платит за токен-планы, поэтому \
токены, кэш, тарифы и агентов ему не объясняют: ему нужно новое решение из этого поста. Пиши \
голосом автора: его оценки и обороты бери как есть, говори прямо.

Карточка — заголовок и от одного до трёх коротких абзацев. Каждая следующая карточка продолжает \
мысль предыдущей и добавляет новое, поэтому читатель листает дальше. Факты и выводы поста бери как \
есть. Условие, которое меняет решение читателя, ставь рядом с утверждением, которое оно меняет.

Цифра и цитата — слова поста: значение цифры и текст цитаты стоят в посте дословно. На карточке \
одна цифра или одна цитата.

Первая карточка — обложка (role cover): повод листать. Последняя — финал (role finale): \
конкретная причина открыть пост, то, чего на карточках ещё нет. Остальным карточкам подбери роль \
по их работе. Поле job — одна фраза о том, что карточка даёт читателю. Картинка нужна обложке и \
тем карточкам, где предмет поста, например интерфейс, терминал, график или счётчик, говорит больше \
слов.

Отвечай одним JSON по схеме. Пиши по-русски."""


def story_file(letter: str) -> str:
    """`stories/<k>.json`: путь от папки прогона."""
    return f"{STORIES_DIR}/{letter}.json"


def plan_file(letter: str, kind: PlanFile) -> str:
    """`plans/<k>.json` или `.md`: производный план слота (DR-11)."""
    return f"{PLANS_DIR}/{letter}.{kind}"


def read_plan(run_dir: Path, letter: str) -> Plan:
    """План слота как вход следующих шагов. Руками правленный или битый файл — `StepInputError`."""
    return read_model(run_dir / plan_file(letter, "json"), Plan)


def answer_file(letter: str) -> str:
    """`generation/story/<k>/answer.json`: первый ответ писателя."""
    return f"{GENERATION_DIR}/{STEP}/{letter}/{ANSWER_JSON}"


def _angle(move: Move) -> str:
    if isinstance(move, GeneratedMove):
        return f"Ракурс: {move.title}. {move.why}"
    return f"Идея автора, держись её: {move.text}"


def _count(analysis: Analysis, limits: CardLimits) -> str:
    if limits.exact is not None:
        return f"Карточек ровно {limits.exact}."
    return (
        f"Карточек от {MIN_CARDS} до {limits.max_cards}: сколько нужно материалу. "
        f"Прикидка по посту: {analysis.card_count}."
    )


def writer_messages(
    post: PostDoc, analysis: Analysis, slot: Slot, limits: CardLimits
) -> tuple[Message, Message]:
    """Задание писателю: читатель, голос автора, ракурс слота, число карточек и пост целиком."""
    reader = analysis.reader
    lines = [f"Читатель: {reader.who}. Знает: {reader.knows}. Хочет: {reader.wants}."]
    if analysis.essence is not None:
        lines.append(f"Голос автора: {analysis.essence.voice}")
    lines += [_angle(slot.move), _count(analysis, limits), "", "Пост:", "", post.to_markdown()]
    return Message(role="system", content=SYSTEM_PROMPT), Message(
        role="user", content="\n".join(lines)
    )


def _markdown(story: Story, plan: Plan, text_caps: TextCaps) -> str:
    cards = "\n\n".join(
        f"Карточка {number}. {beat.role} — {beat.job}\n"
        + "\n".join(value for _, value in card.texts())
        for number, (beat, card) in enumerate(zip(plan.beats, story.cards, strict=True), 1)
    )
    text = f"{cards}\n"
    if text_caps == "warn":
        text += advisory_md(
            [
                check_numbers(story.cards, [beat.role for beat in plan.beats]),
                check_leaks(story.cards),
            ]
        )
    return text


async def run_story(
    run_dir: Path,
    *,
    writers: Sequence[RoleModel],
    prices: Mapping[str, Prices],
    budget_limit: Decimal,
    limits: CardLimits,
    picture_share: float,
    text_caps: TextCaps,
    max_output_tokens: int,
    clock: Clock,
) -> dict[Letter, Story]:
    """История и производный план на каждый слот: ключ — буква слота. Слот `i` берёт писателя `i`
    по кругу."""
    post = read_post(run_dir)
    analysis = read_analysis(run_dir)
    slots = read_selection(run_dir).slots
    roles = {slot.letter: writers[number % len(writers)] for number, slot in enumerate(slots)}
    schema = FreeStory.bound_to(post, limits, picture_share=picture_share)
    calls = {
        f"{STEP}-{slot.letter.lower()}": CallSpec(
            model=roles[slot.letter],
            messages=writer_messages(post, analysis, slot, limits),
            schema=schema,
        )
        for slot in slots
    }
    names = {task: slot for task, slot in zip(calls, slots, strict=True)}
    logged: list[CallMeta] = []
    stories: dict[Letter, Story] = {}
    plans: dict[Letter, Plan] = {}

    def show() -> None:
        items = [
            DirectionTexts(
                slot.letter,
                move_text(slot.move),
                slot.move.thesis if isinstance(slot.move, GeneratedMove) else None,
                plans[slot.letter],
                stories[slot.letter],
                stage=STAGE,
            )
            for slot in slots
            if slot.letter in stories
        ]
        write_texts(run_dir, post, analysis, items)

    def ready(task: str, outcome: CallOutcome[FreeStory]) -> None:
        letter = names[task].letter
        logged.append(outcome.call)
        write_model(run_dir / answer_file(letter), outcome.value)
        stories[letter] = outcome.value.to_story(post)
        plans[letter] = outcome.value.to_plan(stories[letter], analysis)
        show()

    await run_calls(
        run_dir,
        STEP,
        calls,
        prices=prices,
        budget_limit=budget_limit,
        max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens,
        clock=clock,
        on_result=ready,
    )
    files = {name: file_sha256(run_dir / name) for name in (POST_JSON, ANALYSIS_JSON, SELECTED_JSON)}
    models = list(dict.fromkeys(model_id for role in roles.values() for model_id in role.ids))
    write_meta(
        run_dir,
        StepMeta(
            step=STEP,
            role=ROLE,
            models=models,
            limits=limits,
            inputs=files,
            input_sha256=step_digest(STEP, models, files),
            calls=logged,
        ),
    )
    for slot in slots:
        text = _markdown(stories[slot.letter], plans[slot.letter], text_caps)
        write_atomic((run_dir / story_file(slot.letter)).with_suffix(".md"), text.encode("utf-8"))
        write_atomic(
            run_dir / plan_file(slot.letter, "md"),
            plans[slot.letter].to_markdown(analysis).encode("utf-8"),
        )
        write_model(run_dir / plan_file(slot.letter, "json"), plans[slot.letter])
    for slot in slots:
        write_model(run_dir / story_file(slot.letter), stories[slot.letter])
    return stories

"""Общий выход story и directions: настоящие тексты и открытые вопросы (FR-12, US-02)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path

from carousel.nodes.analyze import STEP as ANALYZE_STEP
from carousel.nodes.rundir import meta_file, read_model, write_atomic, write_model
from carousel.reflection import GenerationReport, GenerationSummary, ReflectionNote
from carousel.schemas import Analysis, PostDoc
from carousel.texts_html import TEXTS_HTML, DirectionTexts, render
from carousel.trace import StepMeta

GENERATION_JSON = "generation.json"
ANALYZE_REPORT = "generation/analyze/report.json"


def write_texts(
    run_dir: Path,
    post: PostDoc,
    analysis: Analysis,
    texts: Sequence[DirectionTexts],
) -> None:
    """Сводка рефлексии разбора, затем страница текстов: story и directions пишут одну и ту же."""
    generation = generation_summary(run_dir)
    write_model(run_dir / GENERATION_JSON, generation)
    write_atomic(
        run_dir / TEXTS_HTML, render(post, analysis, texts, generation=generation).encode("utf-8")
    )


def generation_summary(run_dir: Path) -> GenerationSummary:
    """Открытые замечания рефлексии разбора. Писатель отвечает один раз и рефлексии не имеет."""
    reports: dict[str, GenerationReport] = {}
    issues: list[ReflectionNote] = []
    unchecked: list[str] = []
    skipped: dict[str, str] = {}
    path = run_dir / ANALYZE_REPORT
    if path.is_file():
        report = read_model(path, GenerationReport)
        reports[ANALYZE_STEP] = report
        issues += [
            note.model_copy(update={"location": f"{ANALYZE_STEP}: {note.location}"})
            for note in report.reflection.notes
        ]
    else:
        trace = run_dir / meta_file(ANALYZE_STEP)
        calls = read_model(trace, StepMeta).calls if trace.is_file() else []
        if calls and all(call.task in (None, "analysis", "terms") for call in calls):
            skipped[ANALYZE_STEP] = "Исследовательский цикл не настроен: одиночный разбор без рефлексии"
        else:
            unchecked.append(ANALYZE_STEP)
    return GenerationSummary(reports=reports, issues=issues, unchecked=unchecked, skipped=skipped)

"""Шаг story: ход каждого слота → один вызов писателя → история, производный план, след шага.

DR-11, DR-12, CR-07, FR-12, FR-30, FR-60…FR-63, NFR-04; ARCHITECTURE §3, «Узел story» и «След шага».
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections.abc import Sequence
from decimal import Decimal
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest
from fakes import Fails, FakeClock, Says, ScriptedTextModel, solo
from samples import MUSE, THREE, make_selection
from story_samples import free_card, rich_analysis, rich_free_data, rich_post

from carousel.budget import BudgetExceededError, Prices, Usage
from carousel.free_story import FreeStory
from carousel.ideas import GeneratedMove
from carousel.model_call import RoleModel
from carousel.nodes.analyze import ANALYSIS_JSON
from carousel.nodes.rundir import StepInputError, read_ledger, read_model, write_model
from carousel.nodes.story import SYSTEM_PROMPT, answer_file, plan_file, run_story, story_file
from carousel.plan import Plan
from carousel.ports import ModelCallError
from carousel.schemas import CardLimits, Letter
from carousel.story import Story
from carousel.trace import StepMeta

PRICES = {MUSE: Prices(input_per_mtok=Decimal("0.10"), output_per_mtok=Decimal("0.20"))}
USAGE = Usage(prompt_tokens=1000, completion_tokens=500)
LIMIT = Decimal(3)
TASKS = ["story-a", "story-b", "story-c"]


def prepare(root: Path, *, idea: Letter | None = None) -> Path:
    """Папка прогона со входом шага story: богатые пост и разбор и ходы трёх слотов."""
    run_dir = root / "run"
    write_model(run_dir / "post.json", rich_post())
    write_model(run_dir / ANALYSIS_JSON, rich_analysis())
    write_model(run_dir / "moves_selected.json", make_selection(THREE, idea=idea))
    return run_dir


def says_story(**overrides: Any) -> Says:
    return Says(json.dumps(rich_free_data(**overrides), ensure_ascii=False), usage=USAGE)


def writer(
    script: Sequence[Says | Fails] | None = None, *, model_id: str = MUSE
) -> tuple[RoleModel, ScriptedTextModel]:
    """Писатель: по умолчанию отвечает одной и той же каруселью на каждый слот."""
    return solo(list(script) if script is not None else [says_story()] * 3, model_id=model_id)


async def story(
    run_dir: Path,
    writers: Sequence[RoleModel],
    *,
    limits: CardLimits | None = None,
    limit: Decimal = LIMIT,
    picture_share: float = 0.67,
) -> dict[Letter, Story]:
    return await run_story(
        run_dir,
        writers=writers,
        prices=PRICES,
        budget_limit=limit,
        limits=limits or CardLimits(),
        picture_share=picture_share,
        text_caps="warn",
        max_output_tokens=8_000,
        clock=FakeClock(),
    )


def read_meta(run_dir: Path) -> StepMeta:
    return StepMeta.model_validate_json((run_dir / "meta" / "story.json").read_bytes())


# --- что пишет шаг ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def test_dr12_the_step_writes_a_story_a_derived_plan_and_the_first_answer_for_every_slot(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    run_dir = prepare(tmp_path)
    role, _ = writer()

    outcome = await story(run_dir, [role])

    assert set(outcome) == set(THREE)
    for letter in THREE:
        saved = read_model(run_dir / story_file(letter), Story)
        assert [card.role for card in saved.cards][0] == "cover" and len(saved.cards) == 6
        assert saved.cards[0].layout == "cover" and saved.cards[-1].layout == "closing"
        assert (run_dir / story_file(letter)).with_suffix(".md").is_file()
        answer = read_model(run_dir / answer_file(letter), FreeStory)
        assert [card.role for card in answer.cards] == [card.role for card in saved.cards]
        assert (run_dir / plan_file(letter, "md")).is_file()


async def test_dr11_the_plan_is_derived_from_the_text_and_requires_nothing(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    run_dir = prepare(tmp_path)
    role, _ = writer()
    await story(run_dir, [role])

    plan = read_model(run_dir / plan_file("A", "json"), Plan)
    answer = rich_free_data()

    assert plan.count == 6
    assert [(beat.role, beat.job, beat.picture) for beat in plan.beats] == [
        (card["role"], card["job"], card["picture"]) for card in answer["cards"]
    ]
    assert plan.reason == answer["rationale"]
    assert plan.bridge == answer["cards"][-1]["job"]
    assert 0 in plan.beats[0].carries  # тезис 0 лежит в тексте обложки
    plan.validate_indices(rich_analysis())


async def test_fr12_the_writer_shows_real_texts_before_visual_planning(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    run_dir = prepare(tmp_path)
    role, _ = writer()
    outcome = await story(run_dir, [role])

    page = (run_dir / "texts.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert page.count('<div class="card ') == sum(len(item.cards) for item in outcome.values())
    for item in outcome.values():
        for card in item.cards:
            for _, text in card.texts():
                assert escape(text) in page
    assert "Визуальный план ещё не создан" in page
    assert "Картинка:" not in page and "Без картинки" not in page
    assert (run_dir / "generation.json").is_file()
    assert not (run_dir / "visuals").exists()
    assert not (run_dir / "directions").exists()


async def test_fr62_every_call_leaves_a_ledger_line_with_its_task(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    run_dir = prepare(tmp_path)
    role, _ = writer()
    await story(run_dir, [role])

    entries = read_ledger(run_dir)
    assert sorted(entry.task or "" for entry in entries) == TASKS
    assert {entry.step for entry in entries} == {"story"}


async def test_fr61_a_second_run_pays_nothing(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    run_dir = prepare(tmp_path)
    first, _ = writer()
    await story(run_dir, [first])
    ledger = len(read_ledger(run_dir))

    idle, scripted = writer([])
    await story(run_dir, [idle])

    assert len(read_ledger(run_dir)) == ledger and scripted.calls == []

async def test_dr12_the_writer_gets_the_post_the_reader_the_angle_and_the_count(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    run_dir = prepare(tmp_path, idea="C")
    role, scripted = writer()
    await story(run_dir, [role])

    selection = make_selection(THREE, idea="C")
    for call, slot in zip(scripted.calls, selection.slots, strict=True):
        system, user = call.messages
        assert system.content == SYSTEM_PROMPT
        assert rich_post().to_markdown() in user.content

        assert "Карточек от 3 до 10" in user.content
